expected.title: Deterministic positive edge-weight limits for trace-reinforced ants on two parallel paths each of length at least two
expected.author: Daniel Kious; Cécile Mailler; Bruno Schapira
expected.difficulty_reason: General stochastic-approximation results do not rule out the boundary faces or identify a unique interior limit for this conductance-driven reinforcement process. The authors use stopped-time urn couplings to retain every path edge, then recursively enclose the limit set through monotone nonlinear conductance maps. The scalar contraction and uniqueness analysis determines the exact deterministic powers on both paths.
